font.note: The 11pt standard class option uses 10.95pt normal type. Standard Computer Modern mathematics remains in use.

paragraphs.source: Standard article.cls and size11.clo defaults. No overriding paragraph commands in reference.

title.format: Standard article maketitle, centred, no separate title page
title.spacing: Standard article maketitle. Initial 2em, 1.5em before authors, 1em before date, 1.5em after title block.

authors.layout: Centred standard article author tabulars separated with and

date.note: date{} suppresses date text while standard maketitle spacing remains.

captions.revision_instruction: Do not copy the default colon separator. Retain the user ban on visible caption colons.

bibliography.citation_format: Numeric labels in square brackets, inline rather than superscript
bibliography.reference_order: Alphabetical by authors as implemented by plain.bst
bibliography.heading: References, standard article unnumbered section
bibliography.note: No natbib, biblatex or cite package in the reference.

provenance.defaults: Read from local TeX Live 2025 article.cls and size11.clo, the same class files used for this compile.
